then, without limiting the generality of the other provisions of the Loan Documents, and without waiving or<font style="letter-spacing:-0.3pt;"> </font>releasing<font style="letter-spacing:-0.2pt;"> obligation, to pay any sums and to perform any act or take any action as may be appropriate to cause all of the terms, covenants and conditions of the Operating Lease to be performed or observed on behalf<font style="letter-spacing:2pt;"> </font>of Borrower, to the end that the rights of Borrower in, to and under the Operating Lease shall be kept unimpaired and free from default, and Lender
